description: A large crowd of men in white kurtas, white caps and red fezzes fills a plaza in front of a large Mughal-style mosque with domes and tall minarets under a heavy, stormy sky. A man in a dark coat and white trousers stands on a raised wooden platform with one arm raised, addressing the crowd. Several tall cream and gold cloth banners rise above the crowd. No legible text is visible on the banners or elsewhere.
